Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Limessection between WP 4/37 and 4/39 → Fort site and civil settlement
scenicChapters.narrative: 34 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-limessection-between-wp-4-37-and-.story: 282 km from Butzbach to Butzbach, about 4 h 52 of riding. It goes by way of Fort site and civil settlement of Saalburg, Watchtower WP 3/1 to 3/14 including the ci, Watchtowers WP 2/14 to 2/16 and Watchtower WP 1/52. The line favours views over speed.
